primary_scope.definition: Declared 2026-10-11 primary scope: station-side process/safety, public component holdouts and direct-answer SAGA grounding; full-loop, human-effectiveness and non-validation access-boundary checks remain excluded.

interpretation.primary_blocker: independent component-physics holdouts and protocol provenance
interpretation.rule: FAIL은 실패한 주장을 유지하고, PENDING은 증거가 올 때까지 주장하지 않는다.
interpretation.privacy: 원시 행·경로·회사·사이트·제조사·달력 날짜를 이 보고서에 복사하지 않는다.

secondary_diagnostics.claim_boundary: One 20 MPa, 0.37 L, 4 mm pressure-decay trace; no flame, ignition, dispersion, radiation, station control or safety-distance claim.

scope_exclusions.reason: No reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw bundle was identified; the current paper scope is station-side and component validation.
scope_exclusions.paper_limitation: Do not claim independent station-to-vehicle full-loop accuracy, vehicle-controller validation or field-safety validation.
scope_exclusions.reentry_condition: A custodian provides rights-cleared synchronized station and vehicle channels; then freeze a separate prospective protocol before scoring.
